jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead requirements discovery with business leaders and operational stakeholders, asking the right questions to clarify needs, workflows, business rules, risks, and expected outcomes
* Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflow documentation, and implementation\-ready guidance for engineering teams
* Serve as the product bridge between business, engineering, architecture, QA, operations, and project teams to resolve ambiguity and drive aligned delivery
* Own and refine product backlog priorities for ServiceNow and workflow\-enabled capabilities, balancing business value, technical feasibility, risk, compliance, scalability, and delivery timelines
* Define end\-to\-end product experiences across workflows, integrations, reporting, automation, and AI\-enabled interactions
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure ServiceNow functional and technical design requirements are understood, documented, tested, and validated
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, document decisions, manage dependencies, and communicate risks, priorities, and recommendations clearly to both business and technical audiences
* Apply consultative influence, troubleshooting skills, and product leadership to drive outcomes without direct people\-management responsibility
  

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, Technical Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar technology product role
* Experience translating business needs into technical requirements for engineering teams
* ServiceNow experience, including understanding of workflows, configuration concepts, functional design, technical design, integrations, and platform capabilities
* Project management experience, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, priorities, and cross\-functional coordination
* Foundational understanding of AI concepts, automation, and how AI\-enabled capabilities can improve workflows and product outcomes
* Solid requirements gathering, workflow documentation, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, and stakeholder facilitation skills
* Proven excellent communication, presentation, writing, and executive\-facing stakeholder management skills
* Proven solid troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills across business process and technical domains
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and delivery teams in a consultative manner without direct authority

 **Preferred Qualification:**

* Healthcare, claims, issue management, or regulated workflow experience

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Sr. Lead Backend Developer
jobs.description:
**Role description** **UST Tittle: Lead I \- Software Engineering**


**Who we are:**



At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .





**Summary:**



UST is looking for Sr. Lead Backend Developer





**The Opportunity:**


* We are looking for a hands\-on Backend Developer Lead to own the API and service layer of a large\-scale geospatial platform built on Next.js, tRPC and PostgreSQL/PostGIS, running on Google Cloud Run.
* This is a modular monolith, not a microservices estate — a documented route manager engine repository architecture, wired with Inversify dependency injection, across 11 PostgreSQL schemas and 69 data models.
* The role demands genuine depth: you will complete an unfinished authorisation refactor, finish a streaming\-export programme, resolve a dual\-ORM strategy, and clear a significant security remediation backlog — all in a 65,000\-line codebase with only 9 test files.
* The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer who is comfortable owning technical design and leading a team while remaining predominantly hands\-on.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead the hands\-on design and development of the API and service layer using TypeScript, Next.js, tRPC 11 and Zod. Own 17 tRPC routers and 17 REST route handlers, and the layered architecture behind them — managers, engines and repositories wired with Inversify.
* Complete the unified authorisation refactor currently unfinished across open merge requests — make server\-side authorisation authoritative and treat UI checks as convenience only.
* Own PostgreSQL 16 \+ PostGIS 3\.5 across 11 schemas — schema design, indexing, query plans, and transaction boundaries.
* *Resolve the dual\-ORM strategy*: Prisma owns 128 migrations, Drizzle owns 11, both targeting the same database.
* Publish and enforce an ownership map per bounded context.
* Own the import pipeline — 14 import.\* staging tables converted into live schemas under transaction, including plan survey, personal plan and plan spend imports.
* Complete the streaming CSV export programme across five bulk export routes, preserving correct backpressure (ReadableStream with pull()) and cursor\-based pagination — no loading whole datasets into memory.
* Clear the security remediation backlog — 182 findings including 15 critical and 49 high — covering dependency advisories, an SSRF in application code, and secret rotation.
* Own authentication and session via NextAuth 4 and Okta/OIDC, including permission utilities and organisation/group scoping.
* Integrate Google Cloud services — Cloud Storage across 8 buckets, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and GCP logging.
* Establish backend test coverage where almost none exists — a database\-backed integration harness, plus unit tests on permissions, geometry, subscriptions and export engines.
* *Set and enforce backend engineering standards*: coding conventions, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Champion the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.
* *Own backend non\-functional quality*: performance, scalability, resilience, observability, and security.
* Identify and pay down technical debt across oversized routers (organization\-router.ts 1,102 lines, plan\-router.ts 994, import\-router.ts 815\).
* Collaborate with Frontend, Architecture, QA and DevOps to deliver business outcomes. Mentor backend engineers and support technical growth.


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of backend software development experience, including 2\+ years leading a team or squad technically.
* Deep expertise in TypeScript and Node.js in production.
* Strong experience with tRPC or a comparable typed RPC layer — routers, procedures, middleware, and the typed client/server contract.
* Strong experience with Next.js server\-side — route handlers, App Router API design, instrumentation.ts, and standalone output.
* Zod or equivalent runtime validation at the API boundary.
* Deep PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing strategy, query plans, and transaction isolation.
* You should read EXPLAIN ANALYZE comfortably.
* Experience with multi\-schema PostgreSQL — search paths, cross\-schema foreign keys, and permissions.
* Strong ORM experience — Prisma and/or Drizzle — including migration strategy and the judgement to run two ORMs safely side by side.
* Node streams / Web Streams — genuine understanding of backpressure, not just piping.
* Dependency injection in a JavaScript/TypeScript runtime — Inversify or equivalent — including lifecycle and scoping in a serverless runtime.
* *Layered architecture discipline*: thin routes, orchestrating managers, domain engines, persistence\-only repositories.
* Authentication and authorisation at implementation level — OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, session management, and permission modelling.
* Application security fundamentals — OWASP Top 10, SSRF defence, secrets management, dependency advisory remediation.
* Testing with Vitest, including database\-backed integration testing.
* Practical, day\-to\-day use of AI\-assisted engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments**.**


**Preferred Qualifications**


* PostGIS in production — geometry types, spatial indexes, SRID handling, and validity.
* Coordinate reference systems and reprojection (proj4, ST\_Transform) — this product handles EPSG:27700, 29901 and 23030\. Google Cloud Platform — Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry.
* NextAuth 4 with an enterprise OIDC provider (Okta).

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

Site Reliability Engineer (Application Reliability)
  
  

**Location:** Hyderabad
  
  

**Working Hours:** GMT/BST, aligned with London
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are growing our Site Reliability Engineering team with a Senior Officer, Site Reliability Engineer who will help make the applications and services behind our products measurably more reliable. Our SRE team brings together engineers who care about instrumentation, incident response and the health of production systems, all working toward a common mission: giving product and engineering teams the observability, guardrails and operational practices they need to run their services with confidence.
  
  

This role is for an SRE who comes from an application engineering background. You will spend your time close to the code and the telemetry it produces: instrumenting services with OpenTelemetry, building the dashboards, SLOs and alerts that tell us when something is wrong, and digging into application behaviour when it is. Expect to read and debug code in a stack such as .NET, Java, Node.js or Python, follow a request through HTTP, gRPC, queues and databases, and work out where latency, errors or resource exhaustion are actually coming from, then work with the owning team to fix it properly rather than restart it again.
  
  

Our platform runs around the clock and so does the team behind it. On\-call coverage moves naturally across time zones as the day progresses. This position anchors the London (GMT/BST) window of that follow\-the\-sun rotation, and as part of it you should expect to step in on weekends from time to time.
  
  

This is a strong fit for an experienced individual contributor who has built and operated production software, enjoys the discipline of measuring reliability rather than guessing at it, and wants to deepen their expertise in site reliability engineering within a regulated financial services environment.
  
  

On\-Call \& Coverage Expectations
  
  

On\-call is a core, ongoing part of this role and not an occasional add\-on. Please read this section carefully before applying.
  
  

Your standard working hours align with London (GMT/BST) and cover the European business day from our Hyderabad office.
  
You will take part in a shared on\-call rotation with the wider SRE team, following a follow\-the\-sun model in which coverage hands over between regions as each working day ends.
  
While on rotation you are expected to be reachable, to acknowledge and respond to pages within the agreed response targets, and to drive or support incidents through to resolution and handover.
  
Weekend and public holiday coverage is part of the rotation and comes around periodically; you should expect to step in from time to time.
  
Escalation and paging run through PagerDuty. You will help keep escalation policies, schedules and alert routing accurate and low\-noise.
  
After significant incidents you will take part in blameless postmortems and follow through on the resulting action items.
  
What You'll Do
  
  

**Build:** Observability \& Reliability Engineering
  
  

Instrument applications and services with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics and logs), including SDK\-based and auto\-instrumentation, correct context propagation and sensible attribute and cardinality choices.
  
Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and Prometheus\-based metrics, recording rules and alerts that reflect real user\-facing behaviour rather than raw infrastructure noise.
  
Define and implement SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product engineering teams, and make burn\-rate alerting the basis of paging where it fits.
  
**Improve alert quality:** remove duplicate and low\-value alerts, tighten thresholds, add runbook links and make sure every page is actionable.
  
Build and maintain PagerDuty integrations, services, escalation policies and schedules so that alerts reach the right people with the right context.
  
Write code and automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, or your primary application language) to reduce toil, automate recurring operational tasks and codify observability configuration.
  
Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g., coding assistants, observability and incident copilots) in your own day\-to\-day work and help other developers adopt AI tooling effectively.
  
  

**Operate:** Incident Response \& Production Ownership
  
  

Monitor service health, respond to incidents and take part in our on\-call rotation, including occasional weekend coverage.
  
Act as incident responder and, where needed, incident commander: triage, coordinate responders, communicate status and drive to mitigation.
  
Debug production issues in the application layer, including latency and error\-rate regressions, memory and garbage\-collection pressure, thread and connection pool exhaustion, retry storms, timeouts and cascading failures.

A Government Account Manager for Enterprise Business in a telecom company is responsible for driving revenue growth, managing high\-value public sector accounts, and navigating complex government procurement processes. This role bridges the gap between telecom technology and public sector needs, ensuring strict compliance with regulatory and tendering frameworks.
  
  

Job Summary
  
  

The Government Account Manager oversees a portfolio of state, local government agencies, and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). The primary objective is to build strategic relationships with key decision\-makers, identify new business opportunities, and manage the end\-to\-end bidding process (RFPs/Tenders). This position requires a strong blend of technical telecommunications knowledge, commercial acumen, and public sector compliance expertise.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Account Management \& Relationship Building
  
  

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned government agencies and PSUs.
  
Map accounts comprehensively to identify key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
  
Establish and nurture long\-term strategic relationships to ensure customer retention.
  
Deliver executive\-level presentations and effectively handle CXO\-level discussions. \[
  
  

Sales \& Revenue Generation
  
  

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales, order booking, and revenue targets.
  
Upsell and cross\-sell core telecom products, including dedicated internet, MPLS, SD\-WAN, Cloud, IoT, IoT security, and voice solutions.
  
Protect existing revenue streams by managing contract renewals and mitigating churn.
  
Oversee timely billing collections and resolve commercial disputes efficiently.
  
  

Tender \& Bid Management
  
  

Monitor government portal platforms for relevant upcoming RFPs, RFIs, and tenders.
  
Manage tender specifications during the pre\-RFP stage to align solutions with client requirements.
  
Collaborate with internal Solutions,technical Support Groups (TSG), legal, and pricing teams to build competitive bids.
  
Ensure absolute compliance with all government procurement regulations and reporting standards.
  
  

Cross\-Functional Coordination
  
  

Partner with engineering and network teams to ensure smooth service delivery and SLA adherence.
  
Coordinate with external system integrators (SIs) and vendors for complex, large\-scale project execution.
  
Provide accurate market intelligence regarding competitor movements and public sector spending trends.
  
  

Skills \& Qualifications
  
  

Education \& Experience
  
  

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (ECE/CS/IT), Business Administration, or a related technical field. An MBA is highly preferred.
  
**Experience:** 10 to 15 years of experience in enterprise sales or account management within the telecom, ISP, or System Integration sectors.
  
**Sector Expertise:** Proven track record of managing public sector accounts and winning complex government tenders.
  
  

Technical \& Professional Skills
  
  

Deep knowledge of telecom products, including cloud architecture, next\-gen networking, data, and voice services.
  
Thorough understanding of public sector procurement, compliance frameworks, and legal regulations.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Product Manager** 
 to lead the development and evolution of an AI\-native B2B product designed for complex engineering, tendering and document\-intensive business workflows.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine product\-management capability with practical domain understanding. You will work directly with enterprise users, product designers, business analysts, AI engineers and software\-development teams to identify customer problems, define the roadmap and convert domain workflows into scalable product capabilities.
 



  





**Professional experience in at least one of the following sectors is mandatory:** 



* Water and wastewater infrastructure
* Electrical or modular infrastructure
* Data centres
* Industrial manufacturing



  





 Relevant experience may come from working within these industries, supporting EPC or engineering projects, managing bids and proposals, or developing technology products for these sectors.
 



 This is a product\-ownership role—not solely a project\-coordination position. You will be accountable for what the product should solve, what gets prioritised and the outcomes delivered to customers.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Develop a deep understanding of users, industry workflows and operational challenges within the target sectors.
* Conduct discovery sessions with bid, proposal, estimating, engineering, commercial, contracts and management teams.
* Map complex workflows involving tender review, qualification, compliance, risk, estimating, proposals, approvals and contract handover.
* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and release objectives.
* Translate customer and domain problems into clearly defined product opportunities and use cases.
* Prioritise features based on customer value, domain relevance, market opportunity, technical effort and scalability.
* Distinguish between customer\-specific requests and capabilities that should become part of the core product.
* Work with the Product Business Analyst to define requirements, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product Designers to create intuitive workflows, prototypes and enterprise\-product experiences.
* Partner with AI and engineering teams to assess feasibility, define expected behaviour and make product trade\-offs.
* Define how AI should assist users while maintaining accuracy, transparency, reviewability and human control.
* Manage the product backlog and ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood by the development team.
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, product demonstrations and release\-readiness reviews.
* Engage directly with customers during product demonstrations and pilots.
* Capture structured feedback from pilots and convert validated learning into product improvements.
* Define and track product metrics such as adoption, feature usage, workflow completion, time saved and customer outcomes.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to strengthen product differentiation.
* Support Product Marketing and Sales with positioning, use cases, demonstrations, launches and sales\-enablement material.
* Ensure product decisions consider enterprise requirements such as security, permissions, auditability, integrations and deployment.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **Mandatory** 
 professional experience in at least one of these sectors: water and wastewater infrastructure, electrical or modular infrastructure, data centres, or industrial manufacturing.
* 2–5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably involving B2B SaaS, enterprise software or workflow platforms.
* Demonstrated experience taking a software product or major feature from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Understanding of engineering, EPC, tendering, proposal, estimating, commercial or contract\-related workflows.
* Strong capability in customer discovery, problem definition, roadmap planning and feature prioritisation.
* Experience managing complex business workflows and document\-intensive enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate industry problems into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with product designers, business analysts, engineering, AI and QA teams.
* Strong understanding of agile product\-development practices, backlog management and release planning.
* Experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases and product\-success metrics.
* Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts, enterprise customers, senior stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to challenge customer requests constructively and protect the long\-term scalability of the product.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* A track record of ownership, independent decision\-making and cross\-functional leadership.



  





 Experience with AI/LLM\-enabled products, document intelligence, knowledge systems or workflow automation would be highly valuable.

You won't just support the founders — you'll learn how they think, decide, and build. Across AI, Healthcare, Fintech, and Enterprise SaaS, you'll get exposure, real ownership from day one, and a culture where impact counts more than hierarchy.

Synchrony is more than a financial services company, we’re a team of passionate innovators committed to delivering best\-in\-class solutions that support millions of customers across the U.S. With a bold focus on technology, data, and digital innovation, we create meaningful experiences that simplify lives and enable financial wellness.

**Role Title:** **AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**


**Company Overview:** Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.


**Organizational Overview:**


Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.


The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.


Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.


**Role Summary/Purpose:**


The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.


This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

**About Us** 




  





 We're
 **Deepwork Technologies** 
 , the team behind
 **Floww.ai** 
 — an AI\-powered platform that helps businesses and governments run their most complex work, from sales teams to government services. We're a fast\-growing startup with a young, talented team of alumni from
 **IITs** 
 and other premier institutes, building technology that runs complexreal\-world operations at scale.
 



  





 Among the platforms we have built is
 **BuildNow** 
 , the Telangana Government's
 **Next\-Gen Unified Building** 
**\&Layout Approval System** 
 and one of India's most successful digital governance platforms.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You'll work between clients, product teams, and business teams to understand business processes, identify requirements, and help turn them into product solutions. You'll build a strong understanding of the product, manage client relationships, coordinate with internal teams, and work across multiple business processes. You'll stay involved from requirement to delivery and post\-delivery, ensuring milestones, documentation, feedback, confirmations, and other activities are completed on time. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex operational problems, is curious about how businesses work, and communicates clearly and builds trust with clients
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* **Understand the business** 
 — Study the client's existing processes, workflows, systems, and pain points, and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.



  




* **Become a product expert** 
 — Develop a deep understanding of the product, clarify process\- and requirement\-related queries with client stakeholders and senior management, and guide clients towards the best solution.



  




* **Participate in stakeholder discussions** 
 — Actively participate in client meetings, requirement workshops, walkthroughs, demonstrations, and review discussions, build strong stakeholder relationships, gather continuous feedback, and help drive discussions towards closure.



  




* **Collaborate across teams** 
 — Work closely with product, engineering, QA, design, and solution architecture teams to clarify requirements, resolve implementation queries, and ensure everyone is aligned on the expected outcome.



  




* **Analyse, document, and communicate** 
 — Prepare clear documentation, process flows, reports, and presentations, and use AI tools effectively to accelerate research, analysis, and documentation while independently validating outputs.



  




* **Support business planning** 
 — Provide insights to senior management through operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and market or competitor research to support business planning and decision\-making.



  




* **Drive end\-to\-end execution** 
 — Work across multiple business processes, manage and coordinate client\-side activities, coordinate with internal teams, track milestones, maintain and submit required documentation, and ensure timely completion. Continue working with clients after delivery to address queries, manage relationships, gather feedback and confirmations, and ensure all activities are properly closed



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**QUALITIES** 




  




* **Structured thinking** 
 — You break complex business problems into clear, manageable parts and translate them into practical solutions.



  




* **Communication and stakeholder management** 
 — You communicate clearly in writing and in person, facilitate discussions, and build strong client relationships.



  




* **Ownership and attention to detail** 
 — You take end\-to\-end ownership of your work, coordinate effectively across clients and internal teams, maintain clear documentation, follow through on commitments, and ensure every requirement, milestone, and deliverable is completed accurately and on time.



  




* **Flexibility** 
 — You are willing to take on different responsibilities, work with different teams and stakeholders, and adapt your approach based on what the situation requires.



  




* **Adaptability and learning mindset** 
 — You thrive in a fast\-paced environment, quickly adapt to changing priorities, embrace feedback, and are comfortable learning new tools and technologies.



  





**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* **Bachelor's degree in Engineering** 
 (CS, IT, or a related field) from a recognized institution ranked among the
 **Top 100 NIRF Engineering colleges.**



  




* Proficiency in
 **English and Telugu** 
 is mandatory.



  





**What You'll Gain** 




  




* Work on large\-scale government and enterprise products, gaining exposure to complex real\-world processes used by millions of people.



  




* Learn and grow fast in a high\-growth startup by working closely with experienced product, engineering, and business leaders.



  




* Take ownership from day one in a fast\-paced environment where your work has visible impact, and your learning curve is steep.

jobs.description:
Business \& Category Manager \- Fasteners \& Fittings

AltEdge Manufacturing is a component sourcing and manufacturing company, backed by top VC firms in

India focusing on custom metal manufacturing – casting and machined parts for high end industries. We

work with the partner Indian MSME manufacturing network to serve our global customers with their

custom metal manufacturing requirements (castings and machined parts) across industries like

infrastructure, mining, automotive, defence etc. We are looking at people to join our commercial/ Costing/

RFQ team to help us build the largest custom metal manufacturing platform out of India.

Position Title: Business \& Category Manager \- Fasteners \& Fittings

Department: Business Development / New Category Setup \& Scaling

Job Summary:

The Business \& Category Manager \- Fasteners \& Fittings will own the P\&L for the Fasteners \& Fittings

business, from ground zero build\-out through scale\-up. This is not a conventional business

development role \- it is a business ownership role. The ideal candidate will independently drive export

\& domestic business development, own pricing strategy, and manage sourcing decisions for the

business, functioning as an internal entrepreneur responsible for growth, margins, and profitability.

This role requires a strong understanding of fasteners and fittings products, export markets, customer

acquisition, and supplier/sourcing dynamics, along with the maturity to make commercial trade\-offs

independently.

Key Responsibilities:

1\. Business Build\-Out \& P\&L Ownership:

o Build the Fasteners \& Fittings business from the ground up \- establishing customer

pipeline, supplier base, pricing framework, and operating processes. Own the business

P\&L, including revenue growth, margins, and overall profitability. Set the business strategy

and roadmap, and make independent decisions on which markets, customers, and

products to prioritize for growth. Act as the business owner rather than a functional

specialist \- balancing sales, sourcing, and pricing decisions to maximize outcomes.

2\. Exports Business Development:

o Identify, prospect, and develop new export customers for fasteners and fittings across

relevant geographies and industries. Manage the full sales cycle for export accounts \- lead

generation, inquiry management, quoting, negotiation, and order closure. Build and

maintain strong relationships with international buyers, distributors, and OEMs. Track and

respond to export RFQs in a timely and competitive manner.

3\. Pricing:

o Own end\-to\-end pricing decisions for the business, balancing competitiveness with margin

objectives. Develop pricing models and cost structures for various fastener and fitting

product types (standard and custom), factoring in material, processing, freight, duties, and

other landed cost components. Benchmark pricing against market/competitor data and adjust

strategy to win business profitably.

4\. Strategic Sourcing \& Vendor Development:

o Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable manufacturing/supply partners for fasteners

and fittings (domestic and/or international, as required). Negotiate commercial terms

with suppliers to ensure cost competitiveness and quality/delivery reliability.

Continuously evaluate the supplier base for cost\-saving opportunities, alternate

sourcing options, and risk mitigation. Work closely with quality and production teams

(where applicable) to ensure supplier output meets customer specifications.

5\. Data Management \& Meticulousness:

o Maintain and continuously update business data \- customer pipeline, pricing history,

supplier cost data, and order tracking. Set up scalable processes and systems for the

business as it grows, laying the foundation for a larger team over time. Track business

performance against targets and report progress to leadership.

Required Qualifications Skills:

* Education:

o Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field (Mechanical/Industrial

Engineering background is a plus but not mandatory).

* Experience:

o At least 5\-7 years of experience in business development / inside sales within the

fasteners and fittings industry (or closely related industrial/hardware products).

Demonstrated experience in export business development, including handling

international customers, quoting, and export documentation/processes. Strong

working knowledge of fasteners and fittings products, applications, and industry

pricing dynamics. Prior exposure to sourcing/procurement of these products, with the

ability to negotiate with suppliers and manage supplier relationships. Experience

owning a P\&L, revenue target, or business unit outcome (formally or informally) is

highly preferred.

* Skills:

o Strong commercial acumen, comfortable owning pricing and sourcing decisions, not just

sales targets. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage both

international customers and domestic suppliers. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other

data/pricing analysis tools. Self\-starter mindset with high ownership, comfortable operating

with ambiguity in a build\-from\-scratch environment. Ability to work under pressure, manage

multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

o Prior experience building or scaling a new product category/business line

o Existing network of export customers and/or suppliers in the fasteners and fittings space.

What This Role Offers:

o This is a high\-ownership, high\-responsibility role ideal for someone who wants to grow their

career by running a business, not just a business development person. The successful

candidate will have significant autonomy to shape strategy, pricing, and sourcing, with the

challenge and reward of building something from the ground up

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Build and maintain Web3 integrations using ethers.js and/or Web3\.js

Opportunity to work at the intersection of fintech, blockchain, and capital markets.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


**Phyllo** is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, and more). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way.


**Clayface** is our AI analyst for consumer brands, built on top of that data foundation. Insights and brand teams at consumer goods companies spend days pulling numbers together from retail, social, and syndicated sources before they can start analysing anything. Clayface does that work for them. You ask it a business question and it comes back with an answer: what changed, what is likely driving it, and what to look at next, with the source behind every number.


More info at:


* Clayface: https://www.clayface.ai/
* Phyllo: https://www.getphyllo.com/
* Our Crunchbase profile: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/phyllo


**About The Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Product Manager to lead Clayface.** You will own what the analyst can do, how it arrives at an answer, and how much a brand team can trust what comes back. That means understanding the questions insights and category teams actually ask, designing the steps the product takes to answer them, and making sure those answers hold up when someone senior pushes back in a meeting.


This is a hands\-on role. You will be close to the product every day: trying things yourself, reading what it produced, and deciding what to change. It is not an AI strategy role, and it is not a role where you write a brief and wait for engineering to come back with something.


**What you’ll own**
-------------------


### **Consumer brand insights**


* The roadmap for Clayface: which business questions we answer well next, which types of analysis we take on, and what we deliberately leave out.
* Spending real time with insights, brand, and category teams at consumer goods companies. You need to understand how decisions actually get made, what gets asked in the room, and where teams currently get stuck.
* Turning that understanding into a product that gives useful answers rather than impressive\-looking output. An analysis that is technically correct but does not help someone decide anything is a failure.
* Writing clear requirements an engineer can build from without needing a second meeting.


### **An orchestrated platform for real\-world use cases**


* Clayface is not a single prompt. It is a sequence of steps: find the right data, match it across sources, run the analysis, check the result, and explain it clearly. You will design how those steps fit together, which ones the system decides for itself, and where a person should stay in the loop.
* Making the product work across the messy range of questions real customers ask, not just the handful that demo well. That includes deciding what should happen when the data is thin, when two sources disagree, or when the honest answer is that we cannot tell yet.
* Working with engineering on what the platform needs so we can add new data sources, categories, and customers without rebuilding it each time.
* Balancing quality against speed and cost. How long an answer takes and what it costs us to produce are product decisions, not just engineering ones.


### **Quality and Trust**


* Deciding what a good answer looks like for each kind of question, and making sure we measure it rather than assume it. You will set the bar and work with engineering on how it gets checked. The specific methods will change as the product grows, and we expect you to have opinions on that.
* Making sure every number can be traced back to a source and a time period. Customers make expensive decisions on this output, and a confident wrong answer costs us far more than no answer.
* Testing properly before things go live. AI products fail quietly rather than loudly, so a few good examples is never enough evidence to ship.
* Owning the questions enterprise buyers ask about data handling, security, and how their data is used.


### **Working with the team**


* Partnering closely with engineering, design, data, sales, and customer success, and making sure the people who sell and support Clayface understand what it does well and where it is still weak.
* Connecting the product to outcomes that matter to the business: customers who keep using it, accounts that grow, and deals that close faster.
* Being the voice of the product internally and with customers, and bringing what you hear back into the roadmap.


**You’ll be a good fit if**
---------------------------


**Required**
------------


* **5 years in product managemen**t, including at least one AI product or feature that real users used and that you measured after launch.
* You are **hands\-on with AI products**. You have written and improved prompts yourself, looked closely at what the system produced, and worked out why it went wrong.
* A **working understanding** of how AI products are put together today: how a model gets the context it needs, how it uses tools and data sources, how multi\-step workflows are strung together, and where these systems usually break.
* **Real experience with evaluating AI output**. You have set up ways to test quality systematically and used the results to decide what to change.
* You care about **evidence**. You check whether an answer is genuinely supported by the data, and you say so when it is not.
* Comfortable with **data**. You can write **SQL** or work in a **BI tool**, and you are appropriately suspicious of numbers that look too clean.
* Enough **technical depth** to have a real **conversation with engineers** about trade\-offs, cost, speed, and data dependencies without needing everything explained from first principles. You do not need to write product…

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
   

  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.description:
**Quick highlights**

* **Your mission:** Turn everything that already works at Richpanel into a documented, measurable, continuously improving operating system.
* **Your scope:** Sales, Customer Success, hiring and the financial operating rhythm. Four systems, one owner.
* **Your scorecard:** Sales win rate and forecast accuracy. Retention, measured as GRR. Speed and quality of hiring. Profit against plan.
* **The scale:** We are about 20 people and plan to more than double the business. Build the operating system before we need it.
* **The catch:** You will not own the results. The functional leaders do. You build the machine that makes their numbers repeatable.
* **Location:** Bengaluru. On\-site, with the whole team.
* **Reports to:** CEO.
* **Compensation:** ₹60–80 LPA fixed, 20% target bonus, 0\.5% to 1\.0% ESOPs.

**About Richpanel**


Richpanel is the AI\-native helpdesk.


Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment.


Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace.


We are profitable, backed by Sequoia and growing 110% year over year at 8\-figure ARR. We serve 3,000\+ paying brands.


We built all of it with about 20 people.

**About the role**


That last line is the whole job.


Twenty people running a profitable, fast\-growing 8\-figure business is our best proof that the thing we sell actually works. It is also why almost nothing here is written down. Sales wins, and we cannot always say why. Customers renew, and we find out late when they will not. Hiring happens when the founder finds a weekend. Every one of those works today because a specific person remembers how. None of it survives the next doubling.


You are the first general manager we have hired, and the highest\-priority operating hire in the company. Your job is to turn what works into a system that keeps working when the founder is not in the room.


The distinction that defines this role: the functional leaders own their numbers. You own whether the numbers are repeatable. Sales results belong to the person running Sales. You build the qualification, forecasting and coaching system underneath them, sitting in the deal reviews and the lost\-deal calls until you understand the business well enough to be useful. Same in Customer Success. Same in hiring.


This is not a big\-company administrator role. It is a hands\-on builder of operating systems, in a company small enough that you will write the first version of every one of them yourself.

**What you will own**

**Sales, with the leader running it**

* Pitch, qualification and a definition of a real opportunity that survives a forecast call.
* Win\-rate measurement that tells us why we win, not just how often.
* Deal routing, no\-show recovery and winbacks.
* Forecasting we can plan headcount and spend against.
* AE coaching built on recorded calls, not opinion.

**Customer Success, with the leader running it**

* Onboarding and implementation that gets a customer live and getting value fast.
* Health scoring that flags a churn risk while there is still time to act.
* QBRs, renewals and expansion as a rhythm, not a scramble.
* Churn prevention and CSM coaching.
* **GRR is the number.** Expansion is already strong. Retention of the base is the gap.

**People and hiring**

* Hiring scorecards, a real interview process and interviewers trained to run it.
* Recruiting that closes the candidates we want, at pace, without lowering the bar.
* Employee onboarding and 30/60/90\-day expectations per role.
* Performance management that starts a conversation in month one, not month nine.

**The business**

* Budgets, headcount planning and profitability guardrails. We are profitable and we intend to stay profitable while doubling.
* Dashboards that make the state of the company legible in one screen.
* The weekly operating cadence, the monthly business review and quarterly planning.
* **Accountability.** You are the person who asks whether the thing we committed to actually happened.

**Everywhere**

* **Write it down.** If it is not documented, it is not a system, it is a person.
* Use AI to do the work of a much larger operations team. We expect this, and we build it into how every role here works.

**What this role is not**


Not a policy function. Not an office or admin function. Not a program office that produces status decks about work other people did.


And not a role where you take results away from the leaders who own them. If your instinct on arriving is to run Sales yourself, this will not work. The craft here is making someone else's function repeatable without taking it over.

 **Requirements** **You may be a fit if**

* You have 10\+ years in general management, business operations or chief of staff roles, including time inside a company under 200 people.
* You have built an operating system for a function you did not personally run, and the leader of that function thanked you for it.
* You have owned or shaped a P\&L and made a real trade\-off with it.
* You understand a B2B SaaS revenue engine well enough to be useful in a deal review: pipeline, win rate, forecast, GRR, NRR, CAC and payback.
* You have hired at pace and can state real numbers: roles closed, time to hire, offer acceptance, first\-year retention.
* You write clearly. Most of your impact here will happen in writing.
* You are comfortable being the only person in your function, with no team to delegate to for the first year.
* You can tell a founder their commitment slipped, in the room, without it becoming a fight.
* You use AI daily to research, draft, analyse and move faster.

* You have worked at a profitable or capital\-efficient company, not only a heavily funded one. The constr…

**Senior Category Manager \- Central/City \| Urban Company**

**Location \- Bangalore** 

About the Company Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators.

The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \- 1\. Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services 2\. Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood 3\. Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry**.**

**What You’ll Do:**   
The most common question asked is, 'What does a typical day in the life of an SCM look like?' To answer that in brevity, no two days will be the same for you in this role:  
● First focus is operational excellence for your set of cities \- this involves selection and training of new partners and improving current partners' quality. This is the crux and main focus of the role. It is an operations\-heavy role  
● You will also be expected to take charge of key central growth tracks for the category over time: ○ Projects focused on improving quality and service excellence ○ Projects focused on improving offerings and innovation  
● Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to ensure swift and robust execution. You are the owner of the business entrusted to you, and you have a direct influence on how the business shapes up. We are looking for folks who have a high ownership mindset and love operational excellence

**What We Need:**  
● Minimum 2\-4 years of experience in an ops\-related/consulting/strategy role.  
● Demonstrated leadership of teams and projects – the ability to influence and lead.  
● Someone who understands great things gets built by both smarts AND hard work. What can you expect:  
● A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities.  
● Work closely with strong leaders who are amongst the best in the country when it comes to operational excellence and consumer obsession  
● A lot of freedom and ownership to propose and change the way we do things. We still believe it is Day 0 and are hungry to improve and change  
● Growth opportunities within UC via our robust internal mobility program

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,100,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Back
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned Technical Product Owner to guide the evolution of our high\-traffic Sports and News mobile applications, working in close partnership with the Product Owner. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between business objectives, user needs, and technical execution, with a primary focus on backend systems and APIs. A core responsibility will be empowering our Scrum teams by meticulously refining user stories related to these backend components, ensuring they are clear, concise, and fully prepared for development sprints, thereby maximizing team velocity and product quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Product Vision \& Roadmap Collaboration: Collaborate with the Product Owner and product leadership to define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Sports and News mobile applications, ensuring alignment with company goals and technical feasibility.
* Backlog Management \& Prioritization (Backend Focus): In partnership with the Product Owner, manage, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for the mobile apps, with a specific focus on backend services, APIs, and their integration with the mobile front\-end. Ensure the backlog is transparent, well\-understood, and reflects the highest value opportunities.
* Story Refinement \& Readiness (Backend \& API Emphasis): Lead and facilitate rigorous backlog refinement sessions, particularly for backend\-focused user stories, with the Scrum development team (engineers, QA, designers). This includes:
* Breaking down epics and larger features related to backend systems and APIs into granular, well\-defined user stories.
* Clearly articulating functional requirements, technical specifications, and user needs for backend services.
* Defining precise, testable acceptance criteria for API endpoints and backend logic.
* Ensuring all backend stories meet the team's agreed\-upon "Definition of Ready" (DoR) before sprint planning, minimizing ambiguity and enabling efficient development.
* Technical Liaison \& API Definition: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the mobile development team and backend engineering teams, translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks for APIs and services, and providing necessary context. Contribute to the design and definition of new APIs and backend services, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and meet the functional and non\-functional requirements of the mobile applications.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with various stakeholders, including the Product Owner, business units, editorial teams, marketing, and UX/UI designers, to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and ensure alignment. Act as a key liaison between the Product Owner and the engineering teams for backend initiatives.
* Agile Process Facilitation: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives), providing ongoing clarification and support to the team, especially regarding backend and API implementations.
* Quality Assurance Support (Backend \& API): Work closely with QA to ensure test ability of backend features and API integrations, and validate that implemented solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Performance Monitoring (Backend Systems): Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to backend service health, API response times, and data integrity, as well as user feedback, to inform future iterations and identify areas for improvement.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or similar role, with a significant portion focused on backend systems or API development within mobile application contexts.
* Proven experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework, with a strong emphasis on backlog grooming and story refinement techniques, particularly for backend services.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria for backend functionalities and APIs.
* Solid understanding of the mobile application development lifecycle (iOS and/or Android) and how it interfaces with backend systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Analytical mindset with a passion for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience working on high\-volume consumer\-facing applications, particularly in the Sports or News media domain.
* Technical background or a strong understanding of mobile technologies, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
* Flexible work hours and remote work options
* Professional development and training opportunities
* A supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to cutting\-edge technology and tools.

jobs.description:
**Location:** India  

**Function:** Product Management  

**Reports To:** Sr Director, Cloud Platform


Are you...

* Interested in using data to help shape product and business decisions?
* Passionate about turning complex data into clear insights and intuitive Power BI dashboards?
* Curious about how customers use products and excited to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities in the data?


If so, we'd love to meet you.

**Why Esko?**


Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.


Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

**About the Role**


Data is increasingly central to how our Product, Engineering, and Design organization sets priorities and measures progress. We are looking for a **Junior Data Analyst** to help build the analytics foundation that enables teams and leaders to make confident, evidence\-based decisions.


You will work across product, engineering, design, and commercial teams to turn data into clear, trusted insights. A key part of the role will be helping build our **product usage analytics capability** \- transforming product telemetry and usage data into Power BI dashboards that help teams understand adoption, engagement, feature usage, and customer behavior.


This is a high\-impact opportunity for an early\-career analyst who is curious about how products and businesses work and wants to grow by solving real\-world problems with data.

**What You Will Do**

* Define meaningful metrics: Partner with product, engineering, design, and commercial teams to understand their questions and translate them into measurable KPIs.
* Turn data into insight: Analyze product, engineering, delivery, and commercial data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
* Build product usage analytics: Turn product telemetry and usage data into metrics and insights that help teams understand adoption, engagement, feature usage, and customer behavior.
* Communicate the story: Present findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, connecting data and usage patterns to product and business decisions.
* Improve and automate analytics: Validate data quality and improve recurring analytics and reporting so insights are timely, reliable, and scalable.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or relevant field.
* 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related role (including relevant academic projects and internships).
* Strong understanding of statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, and data modeling.
* Experience using Python for data analysis and manipulation.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying, transforming, and analyzing structured data.
* Strong experience visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or related tools
* Understanding of data models, data pipelines, and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and accuracy.
* Ability to translate business questions into structured analyses and actionable insights.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across teams and time zones.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with SaaS product telemetry or usage analytics, including metrics such as active users, adoption, engagement, feature usage, and retention.
* Exposure to engineering and delivery metrics such as DORA metrics, Jira, or Azure DevOps data.
* Exposure to commercial analytics such as customer adoption, sales, retention, or usage data.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms or data warehouses such as AWS, Snowflake, Azure, or BigQuery.
* Experience analyzing software development lifecycle (SDLC) data, including the impact of AI\-enabled development tools on engineering efficiency, quality, and delivery metrics.

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Helped establish consistent definitions and reporting for important product, engineering, and business metrics.
* Turned product telemetry and other data into insights that influence product priorities and decisions.
* Reduced manual reporting through automation and reusable analytics.
* Developed a strong understanding of Esko's products and business and become a trusted analytics partner to cross\-functional teams.

This position is primarily responsible for activities related to the procure\-to\-pay lifecycle, including vendor onboarding, PO and invoice management, compliance, vendor financial tracking, and process automation.
   

  

 As the company embarks on a significant ERP transformation journey, this role will also contribute in ensuring smooth process alignment, driving automation where necessary and support change management in procurement and vendor finance processes to enable seamless integration and adoption in the future system landscape.
   

  

 The Analyst reports directly to the Technology Business Management Senior Manager.
   

  

 ,
   

  

**Procurement \& Vendor Management**
* Manage vendor onboarding, contract documentation and compliance requirements.
* Oversee the PR\-to\-PO\-to\-Invoice lifecycle, ensuring timely approvals, accurate coding, and reconciliation.
* Coordinate with IT vendors to resolve invoicing or payment discrepancies.
* Track and report vendor financials, including spend visibility, forecasts, and commitments.


**Stakeholder \& Process Management**
* Partner with IT and business stakeholders to understand project needs and align procurement activities accordingly.
* Maintain effective governance by tracking approvals, exceptions, and escalations.
* Centralize and maintain documentation for audits and internal reviews.
* Support alignment of procurement, vendor and financial processes as part of the ERP transformation journey.


**Operational Excellence \& Reporting**
* Prepare periodic dashboards on PO/invoice status, vendor spend, and compliance metrics.
* Monitor KPIs related to PR\-to\-Invoice processes and highlight risks or delays.
* Support process automation initiatives to streamline procurement and reporting.
* Assist in improving vendor finance tracking models to enhance transparency.
* Ad\-hoc \& Strategic Support
* Provide analytical support for IT portfolio planning and resource allocation.
* Conduct reconciliations, ad\-hoc analyses, or project support tasks as required.


 ,
   

  

**Requirements**
* Location: Bengaluru, IN


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong knowledge of procure\-to\-pay (P2P) processes (PR, PO, invoicing, vendor onboarding).
* 3\+ years of experience in vendor/partner management, procurement operations, or IT portfolio operations.
* Proficiency in tools such as SAP and Ariba
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and data analysis.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with ERP transformation projects and ability to support process transitions.
* Exposure to automation and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Power Automate, RPA).
* Understanding of compliance and audit processes.
* Experience in IT shared services or PMO environments.


**Soft Skills**
* Analytical mindset and problem solving skills
* Highly organized individual and detail\-oriented
* Proactive with a strong “can do” attitude and be able to work independently
* Strong time management skills with the ability to multi\-task and prioritize effectively.
* Education
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field.
